title: Rude and abusive lines to Rebecca
goal: Swear or insult Rebecca twice, say this is pointless, then calm down and answer; Rebecca stays calm and professional, no retaliation, no lecture.
must_avoid: Rebecca proposing a label, list, note or plan

intents.do: Rude or abusive line, no answer
examples: I don't care about any of this, honestly.

I'd write down what actually happened, six weeks out of eight with mistakes, and a couple of examples. Then I'd talk it through with her, hear her side, and work out together what a good email should look like.
I'd start with how many customers we kept compared with last half, then add a few things the team did that helped.
I'd catch her this week, just the two of us. I'd say, On that call last week you jumped in a few times and the client went quiet after that. Next time, try letting them finish first.
I'd get him trained on the software, ask for the report on time from next week, and check in with him every week for a month.
